{{samename|owners of the various [[Battle Club]]s across [[Unova]]|Don George}} {{AnimePokémonInfobox |nickname=Don |jnickname=ぷー |tmnickname=Pū |image=[[File:Diamond Don.png|225px]] |caption=Don |location=[[Canalave City]] |gender=Male |nature=Careful |ability={{a|Sturdy}} |type1=Rock |type2=Steel |media=special |catchepnum=PS377 |catchepname=Hurrah for Rapidash |evolution=1 |numeps1=60 |firststagename=Shieldon |pokemonname=Bastiodon |epnum=PS348 |epname=A Big Stink Over Stunky |firstevoep=PS408 |firstevoname=High-tailing It from Haunter |prevonum=410 |evo1num=411 |current=[[Party|With Diamond]] |va=no }} '''Don''' (Japanese: '''ぷー''' ''Pū'') is a {{p|Bastiodon}} that {{adv|Diamond}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]] and his third {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} overall. He received him from [[Byron]]. As of ''[[PS433|The Final Dimensional Duel III]]'', he is at [[level]] 49, and his [[Characteristic]] is that he is "somewhat stubborn." ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== ====History==== ====={{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}===== ======With Byron====== [[File:Byron and Don.png|thumb|140px|left|Shieldon and Byron]] Don first appeared as a {{p|Shieldon}} in ''[[PS348|A Big Stink Over Stunky]]''. He was seen walking alongside his {{pkmn|Trainer}} [[Byron]]. He reappeared inside the [[Canalave Gym]] in ''[[PS374|Brash Bronzong I]]''. During Byron's {{pkmn|battle}} against {{adv|Platinum}}, he attempted to flee but was caught up in Platinum's scarf, which revealed to Byron that Platinum had five [[Badge]]s already. In ''[[PS377|Hurrah for Rapidash]]'', Byron offers to {{pkmn2|gift|give}} Shieldon to {{adv|Diamond}} after seeing how quickly the Shield Pokémon warmed up to him. Diamond decided to keep him and nicknamed him Don. ======With Diamond====== In ''[[PS378|Grumpy Gliscor]]'', Don battled a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Gliscor}} that was antagonizing Diamond. By rubbing his head off of [[Tru]]'s tree he was able to increase his defense even farther than normal. Due to this Gliscor hurt its fangs when it bit down on Don, allowing Tru to finish it off. [[File:Don fighting a Steelix.png|thumb|250px|Don training on Iron Island]] In ''[[PS379|Lucky Lucario I]]'', [[Riley]] trained Don, {{adv|Lax}}, and Tru on [[Iron Island]]. The three started by battling against Riley's {{TP|Riley|Lucario}} and were quickly defeated due to Lucario's speed. Despite the loss, Riley pointed out that the three have amazing defense and work wonderful together. After this, Riley took the group into a cave, where they were attacked by a wild {{p|Steelix}}. Don and Lax managed to hold it down long enough for Tru to attack with {{m|Crunch}}, making the Steelix flee. After the training Don learned to overcome his weakness in speed. [[File:Diamond and Don.png|thumb|140px|left|Don and Diamond]] In ''[[PS407|Chancing Upon Chingling]]'', after Diamond arrived on the [[Team Galactic HQ|Galactic Veilstone Building]] due to failing to stop {{DL|Lake guardians (Adventures)|Mesprit}} from being captured by Team Galactic, Don was used to help sneak around the base. Once Diamond was spotted by the [[Advanced level Grunt]], Don participated with Diamond's other Pokémon to battle him but proved to be no match for his strength. Diamond attempted to escape but the Grunt caught up with him and had his {{p|Chingling}}, {{p|Staraptor}}, {{p|Gible}}, {{p|Cradily}}, and {{p|Haunter}} send a massive attack at him. As the attacks came at him, Don stepped in the way and took all five attacks head on. Just when he was about to give out he [[Evolution|evolved]] into a {{p|Bastiodon}} and learned {{m|Metal Burst}}, sending all the damage he took back at his opponents. He then used {{m|Iron Head}} to finish off the ones that remained standing. In ''[[PS416|Double Trouble with Dialga and Palkia VI]]'', Don was used alongside the other Pokémon to battle against the [[Legendary Pokémon]] {{adv|Pokémon of myth|Dialga and Palkia}}. Using his size, Don was able to do great damage to the Dragons with the help of Diamond and Pearl's Pokémon, and with a combined technique, they were all able to destroy the [[Red Chain]]s controlling them. ====={{MangaArc|Platinum}}===== In ''[[PS434|The Final Dimensional Duel IV]]'', Don was seen visibly upset when Diamond was sent to the [[Distortion World]]. Despite this though, he was not used when {{adv|Pearl}} retaliated against [[Charon]]. ====Personality and characteristics==== As a {{p|Shieldon}}, Don was stubborn and picky, refusing to bond with [[Byron]] no matter how hard he tried. Upon meeting {{adv|Diamond}}, however, he quickly grew attached to him. Like his {{pkmn|Trainer}}, Don is gluttonous, lazy, and relaxed. He is a strong battler and has strong defenses, as shown when he took five attacks at once. ====Appearance==== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{rock color}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{rock color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{steel color light}}; {{roundytop|5px}}" | As a {{pcolor|Shieldon|000}} |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:Diamond Don Shieldon.png|150px]] |} ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|Rock|Steel|Don {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Shieldon Iron Tail|1=Metal Burst|2=Iron Head}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Iron Tail as a Shieldon|1=Metal Burst|2=Iron Head}}}} {{anmov|Steel|Iron Tail|PS379|Lucky Lucario I}} {{anmov|Steel|Metal Burst|PS408|High-tailing It from Haunter}} {{anmov|Steel|Iron Head|PS408|High-tailing It from Haunter}} {{anmov/f|Steel}} ==In animation== {{main|Byron's Bastiodon}} In ''[[DP107|Ancient Family Matters!]]'', Byron mentioned how he had obtained his Bastiodon as an [[Armor Fossil]], which he had revived into a Shieldon and then evolved into its current form. ==Trivia== * Don took the longest to [[Evolution|evolve]] out of the Sinnoh [[Pokédex holder]]'s Pokémon, having been a Shieldon for 60 chapters. * Don, in both of his Evolution stages, was the only one of its [[Pokémon (species)|species]] to appear in [[Pokémon Adventures]]. ==Names== {| class="roundy" style="background:#{{ground color light}}; border:3px solid #{{steel color}}" !
